title: It Worked Once. Can the Customer Run It Again?
excerpt: Before removing scheduled onboarding help, watch the customer run one real task with the access and support they’ll have next week.
primary_goal: Decide whether to hand over one customer workflow, hand over part of it or keep scheduled help in place.
primary_cta: Put the next real run of one workflow on the calendar and use the Second Run Check to decide who owns what afterward.
playbook_description: A one-page worksheet for deciding when a customer can take over a workflow after an assisted first run.

subject_variants.subject: It worked once. Can the customer run it again?
subject_variants.preheader: One real workflow, one more run, and a clear decision on what the customer can take over.
